why: DMN 1.6 §10.3.2.3.4: "A time in the semantic domain is a value of the XML Schema time datatype." XML Schema Part 2 §3.2.7.3, the lexical representation of a timezone: "'+' indicates a nonnegative duration, '-' indicates a nonpositive duration." The text of an offset takes the sign of the offset, also below one hour (-00:30, -00:00:30).
